name: SEC EDGAR
summary: US public company filing histories and XBRL financial data (company facts, single concepts, cross-company frames) from the SEC's free EDGAR APIs.

user_agent.description: the User-Agent the SEC asks automated clients to declare: a company or name and an admin contact email, e.g. 'Sample Company Name AdminContact@example.com'

notes: Keyless, but the SEC asks every automated client to declare a User-Agent with a name and contact email; set SEC_EDGAR_USER_AGENT.
Fair access: at most 10 requests per second across all your machines; heavier use is throttled.
CIKs in data.sec.gov paths are zero-padded to 10 digits (CIK0000320193). Map a ticker to its CIK with tickers.list.
XBRL data covers standard taxonomies (us-gaap, ifrs-full, dei, srt) only, not company-custom tags. For bulk work the SEC publishes nightly companyfacts.zip and submissions.zip instead.

endpoints.name: List tickers and CIKs
endpoints.summary: Every ticker with its CIK and EDGAR company name, as one JSON file.
notes: A single file of all companies; filter it locally. Updated periodically, accuracy not guaranteed by the SEC.

endpoints.name: Get a company's filings
endpoints.summary: Names, tickers, exchanges and filing history (form, date, accession number, primary document) of one filer.
notes: Holds at least one year or the 1,000 most recent filings, whichever is more; older ones are in additional files the response lists.

endpoints.name: Get all XBRL facts of a company
endpoints.summary: Every reported value of every standard concept for one company.
notes: Returns every concept in one response; use facts.concept for one line item.

endpoints.name: Get one XBRL concept of a company
endpoints.summary: All reported values of one concept (e.g. Revenues) for one company, per unit.

taxonomy.description: Taxonomy: us-gaap, ifrs-full, dei or srt.

endpoints.name: Get one concept across companies
endpoints.summary: The latest value of one concept for one period from every filer that reported it.

taxonomy.description: Taxonomy: us-gaap, ifrs-full, dei or srt.

unit.description: Unit of measure, e.g. USD, shares, or a ratio like USD-per-shares; pure for unitless.

period.description: CY#### annual, CY####Q# quarterly, CY####Q#I instantaneous (balance-sheet items).

notes: Each filer contributes one fact, from its most recent filing that best fits the calendar period, so start and end dates differ across companies.
